title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: misdeclaration penalty rates and inspection cost recovery by category
content:
## What this card covers
This card gives, for each acceptance category of the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the misdeclaration penalty per container found carrying goods other than declared, the maximum misdeclaration penalty per acceptance, and the inspection and handling cost recovered when a misdeclaration is found.

## Rates by category
| Category | Penalty per affected container (USD) | Penalty cap per acceptance (USD) | Inspection cost recovery (USD per acceptance) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 15000.00 | 75000.00 | 250.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 15000.00 | 75000.00 | 350.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 25000.00 | 125000.00 | 450.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 30000.00 | 150000.00 | 550.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 30000.00 | 150000.00 | 550.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 35000.00 | 175000.00 | 950.00 |

## Reading the rates together
In every category the cap per acceptance is five times the penalty per affected container. The inspection cost recovery is a single figure per acceptance and does not vary with the number of containers.

## Basis Q&A
- *Do AHL DG Limited Quantity and AHL DG Class 9 Standard share their penalty figures?* Yes, both the per-container penalty and the cap; they differ only in the inspection cost recovery (250.00 against 350.00).
- *What is the highest inspection cost recovery?* 950.00, under AHL DG Special Approval.
